description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity class named CollectionDemoActivity. It manages a collection of fragments displayed within a ViewPager, handles navigation including 'up' navigation via the action bar, and defines nested classes for the pager adapter and fragment used within the activity.
external_files: android support library classes: Fragment, FragmentActivity, FragmentManager, FragmentStatePagerAdapter, NavUtils, TaskStackBuilder, ViewPager
Android basics: ActionBar, MenuItem, Intent, Bundle, View, TextView

classes.name: CollectionDemoActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying a collection of items using ViewPager with fragment management and navigation controls.

classes.name: CollectionDemoActivity.DemoCollectionPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class extending FragmentStatePagerAdapter, providing fragments for each item in the collection.

classes.name: CollectionDemoActivity.DemoObjectFragment
classes.description: Fragment class representing a single item in the collection, displaying a number.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, configures ViewPager and adapter, and sets up action bar.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item selections, specifically the home (up) navigation.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns a fragment for a given position in the collection, creating a new DemoObjectFragment instance.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns total number of objects in the collection (100).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for each page based on position.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the view for DemoObjectFragment, inflating layout and setting a number.
